ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity; approximately 92% dark pixels (black/dark grey) to 8% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark field with sparse, randomized white punctate speckles across both lobes; dense, high-contrast white-to-beige clusters localized at the lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 52 degrees with a bounding-box depth extending roughly 18% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire margin; pixel amplitudes of peaks vary between 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex sweep from notch to tip with a secondary upward-curving distal taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located at the far left and far right terminal ends of the lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several visible thin, unaligned white linear markings on the right lobe, including one prominent diagonal mark in the upper-medial quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified biological growth (barnacles) concentrated on the outer edges and tips of both lobes; visible physical protrusions at the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Suspended water droplets and wake turbulence visible at the air-water interface directly below the trailing edge.
